"""Guards against the N+1 regression: listing notes must cost a constant number of queries."""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from notes.app import app, get_db
from notes.db import connect


@pytest.fixture
def traced(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(tmp_path / "notes.db"))
    queries: list[str] = []

    def traced_db():
        conn = connect()
        conn.set_trace_callback(queries.append)
        try:
            yield conn
        finally:
            conn.close()

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = traced_db
    yield TestClient(app), queries
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()


def _list_query_count(client, queries, params=None) -> int:
    queries.clear()
    assert client.get("/notes", params=params).status_code == 200
    return sum(q.lstrip().upper().startswith("SELECT") for q in queries)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("params", [None, {"tag": "t"}])
def test_list_query_count_is_constant(traced, params):
    client, queries = traced
    client.post("/notes", json={"title": "a", "body": "b", "tags": ["t", "u"]})
    few = _list_query_count(client, queries, params)
    for i in range(40):
        client.post("/notes", json={"title": f"n{i}", "body": "b", "tags": ["t", "u"]})
    assert _list_query_count(client, queries, params) == few


def test_tags_keep_insertion_order(traced):
    client, _ = traced
    client.post("/notes", json={"title": "a", "body": "b", "tags": ["z", "a", "m"]})
    assert client.get("/notes").json()[0]["tags"] == ["z", "a", "m"]

notes: Asserts query count, not wall time, so the test is deterministic on any machine.
